walked by kennel noticed canine had soft wiggly body. called to front of kennel canine came up and pushed body onto kennel door allowing petting through kennel. sniffing and licking handlers hand. throughout interaction canine was wiggly and solicits attention through kennel door
11/8/2026
Soft and wiggly at front of kennel, seeking attention from handler.
11/1/2026
Dog was jumping up while demand barking when approaching kennel gate.  Offered treats to help settle dog.  Would jump up during leash placement.  Walked with a strong pull on leash while having hackles raised along spine & a flagged tail, attempting to fence fight with nearby dogs, able to use leash to guide away from nearby kennels.  Once in small PY, dog would start to pace along fence line while panting heavy.  Approached handler & would start to jump up while being mouthy towards handlers hands & arms.  Would nip @ handlers long sleeves, pulling back, able to direct dog to stop while tossing treats away from handler.  Each time handler would attempt to sit on chair, dog would start to jump up towards handlers face, opted to remain standing.  Was not interested in toys.  Would alarm bark towards another handler while walking past PY, keeping tail flagged & hackles raised, would do a shake off of body when out of sight, relaxing tail & hackles.  Would not settle in PY, continuously jumping up & bounding off of handler, nipping @ sleeves & pacing throughout PY.  Handler would pick up leash, dog would start to bite @ leash, able to stop with treats in hand.  Walked back to kennel while quickly flagging tail, raising hackles & attempting to fence fight, able to use leash to guide dog away from nearby kennels.  Entered into kennel with treats being tossed into kennel.  Removed leash by hand without issues.
10/31/2026
Fast tail wag, wiggly body on approach, easy to leash. Exited quickly, hackles raised but did not attempt to engage with neighboring dogs. Outside, dog walked with moderate excited pull, zig zag, needed some direction. In yard, dog immediately began jumping up against handler, panting, pupils dilated, tail wagging. Handler used straight-arm to keep dog off, distracted with stuffed toys. Dog briefly carried toy, dropped it and began growling, alarm barking towards dogs outside of yard. Resumed jumping on handler, appeared unfocused, easily distracted. Handler walked dog inside for quieter environment. Dog continued to frantically jump up against handler, whining, panting. Handler kept leash short, sat down on chair, dog put front feet in lap, trying to climb all the way up. Handler kept hold of leash, spoke gently, petted dog. Dog had very high energy, appeared anxious, paced room, then returned to handler, continuing to jump. Occasionally mouthed hands and arms, minimal pressure, stopped without being corrected. Chased toys when thrown. Dog did not fully settle, but after several minutes dog laid on floor, legs splayed out, panting. Returned to handler, allowed all petting. Walked with light pull on return, hackles raised when passing dogs in yard. Directed into kennel without issue, removed leash by hand.
10/27/2026
Dog allowed leashing. Jumps on handlers, pulls on leash, barks at dogs passing. Dog shook and wiggled out of restraint while whining when trying restraining for vaccines. Dog got out of muzzle wrap and nipped towards handlers hand but did not make contact. Dog walked to kennel, jumpy and pulled hard on leash.

Handler was able to redirect verbally by saying "NO" firmly, dog would lay down then stand up & do a shake off of body, returning to exploring.  Dog would approach handler again, allow more petting while having a relaxed body then started to do zoomies.  Dog would defecate then dragged leash through feces.  Handler picked up leash to wipe off, dog would start to jump up against handler while nipping @ handlers sleeves, able to direct off without issues.  Dog would approach handler from behind again, wrapping front paws around handlers legs & licking @ handlers pant legs, handler would say "NO" firmly again, dog would release & lay down while rolling over to expose belly.  Handler walked away, dog would return to exploring with nose to ground while having a soft tail wag.  Handler approached dog & picked up leash.  Walked back to kennel with a moderate pull on leash while jumping up & walking in a zig zag pattern.  Entered into kennel without issues & removed leash by hand.
11/4/2026
Dog was closed outside for cleaning, standing at gate with soft face and wagging tail. Accepted treats. Sniffed leash for several moments before allowing placement. Exited kennel, walked mostly loose leash, appeared interested in calm dogs, easily startled by reactive ones and kept distance from them. Some stop and go to sniff, light pull, no issues directing to play yard. Dog explored yard with loose body language, wagging tail, easily distracted by sights and sounds. Handler sat on bench, called dog, dog ran over and leaned in, allowed all petting, appeared energetic. Dog jumped up against handler, "held" onto handler's arm with front legs; handler was unsure if dog was mounting or just holding on tightly. Dog rubbed face against handler's jacket arm, lightly mouthed. Handler stood, directed dog down with light leash pressure. Dog settled, leaned in, allowed more petting. Demonstrated "sit" command, took treats. Jumped up again, nuzzling snout into handler's jacket sleeve, then began nibbling with front teeth, pinched skin under sleeve but did not break skin. Dog remained soft and affiliative with handler but was appearing to become over-aroused. Easy walk back, wagged tail when passing other dogs. Entered kennel with light guidance, allowed leash removal by hand.
11/1/2026
Requesting a full evaluation based on intake observation notes.

sections.evaluation_comments:
11/3/2026
Outside for AM cleaning laying flat on ground in middle of kennel, stoic, whale eye, no interest in treats or coaxing. Dog slowly got up with slow loose tail wag when leash was presented, came forward to eat treats tossed near but wary of leash and quickly retreated to back of kennel, hiding head in divider pocket, flinching heavily when touched with leash, would pancake and rest head along wall so leash could not be secured, offered dog treats and able to slowly place leash. Froze in place, would not walk on leash, positioned taxi at front of kennel and dog entered taxi on own, rode fine to small play yard, touch sensitive but tolerated petting on head. In yard dog slowly crawled out of taxi, tail tucked, did not venture far from taxi and pancaked underneath nearby chair, stoic, little eye contact with handler, would only eat treats tossed near and did accept treats gently but would not move from original spot, did not follow treat trail. Touch sensitive when petted, skin crawled heavily when first touched but does settle and became more tolerant of petting on head/body, scanning environment slowly throughout. Let dog have a few moments, remained pancaked when picking up leash, positioned taxi in front of dog and dog walked into taxi on own. No issues with return, exited taxi into kennel slowly, very subtle/slow attempt to dash out of kennel but settled when door was closed, able to remove leash by hand with no issues.
11/2/2026
Dog was standing in back half of kennel on approach, slowly came forward for treats to front half of kennel.  Presented leash, dog would start to walk back towards kennel divider, slowly closed divider.  Dog would turn around & face handler while tossing more treats into kennel.  Would dodge leash placement, able to secure leash after a couple attempts while dog would have ears flattened, licking lips & keeping head lowered.  Walked out of kennel with verbal coaxing then would stand still bodied in front of behavior taxi.  Tossed treats into behavior taxi, dog would follow treat trail.  Rode to small PY without issues.  Would explore with nose to ground.  Would not come towards handler when called or for treats.  Would become still bodied while keeping head lowered each time handler would approach dog.  Tolerated petting without reaction.  Repositioned behavior taxi then tossed treats inside, dog would slowly walk back into behavior taxi.  Rode well back to kennel.  Exited into kennel with treats to coax.  Would start to pull back on leash as handler would extend hand to remove leash.  Handler would drop a jackpot amount of treats @ front of kennel to coax forward again then removed leash by hand while dog would be eating treats.
10/30/2026
Requesting full eval based on intake and previous notes.
10/28/2026
Approached ASO first took food, allowed for a slow leashing, did NOT walk on leash, thrashed and bit at leash but settled when pressure was released, was able to muzzle wrap and load into truck kennel without issue.
10/28/2026
ACO went out to truck and attempted to place K9 into small bucket, K9 jumped out and pancaked onto sally port, ACO muzzle wrapped K9 and picked up and carried onto ramp, vaccines were given with muzzle wrap and minimal restraint, K9 was picked up and placed into deeper bucket,second leash was placed to help K9 stay in bucket, taxied to kennel, K9 was picked up and placed into kennel, allowed for leash removal.
10/28/2026
Dog needed to be moved due to guillotine not working. When handler approached kennel, dog engaged with handler by looking at handler with soft eyes while laying on ground. Handler was able to leash dog with no issues and was able to coax dog out of kennel with no problems. Once out of kennel, dog froze and sat down. After some gentle coaxing, dog was able to walk out of building on leash with no issues. Once outside, dog stopped and pancaked on to ground. Handler tugged on leash gently which got the dog to stand up on all fours. When handler tugged again on leash to move forward, dog started thrashing on leash. Handler stopped to let dog settle down and then tried to move dog again after a few moments. Dog again thrashed on leash and started lip licking. Handler called for assistance and when assistant arrived, handler instructed assistant to close in all guillotines so other dogs in kennel building were not present while trying to move dog closer to outside kennel. Once all dogs were secured inside, handler tried to walk dog to kennel once more when dog began to thrash on leash again. Handler then called for additional assistance. While waiting for more assistance, first assistant started to present treats and create a treat trail for dog. Dog was not interested in treat trail. When additional assistance came, they asked for a bucket to place dog into. First handlers leash was on dog but was under dogs front legs resulting in 2nd handler needing to place their leash on dog. Once the second leash was secured on dog, original handler dropped leash and 2nd handler took over. Second handler was able to get dog into bucket by lifting dog with leash into bucket. When dog was in bucket, handler moved dog into kennel and dog got out of bucket with no issues. Handler then was able to remove both leashes while the dog was in kennel. Dog's body was stiff, had wide but soft eyes with little whites, and dog lip licked throughout the entirety of the movement however no other FAS behaviors were present.

Outside for AM cleaning with soft tail wag, neutral soft body, accepted treats gently. Wary of leash, began pacing in back of kennel with tail tucked, head lowered, hunched over body, placing head in divider pocket, able to slowly approach and lasso leash with no issues. Exited kennel with slight erratic-ness, pulled hard towards neighboring kennel and froze, tail tightly tucked, wide eyed, tense bodied, wary of surroundings, able to be coaxed thru, easy slow leash pull to small play yard, stop n go due to being startled, hesitant to pass by reactive dogs, pulls away from handler at times but able to coax thru to yard. In yard dog tolerated pets on back when placing leash stopper, began pacing with tail tucked and hunched over tense body, wary of handler at first but started to approach for treats offered and accepted treats gently, would sit in front of handler accepting pets all over with trembling observed in back legs but wagging tail and soft body, leans in for pets, when not being petted or offered treats will continue to pace around yard. Came to handler when called over to leave, walked back to kennel with no issues. Hesitant and wary to enter kennel, began biting thru leash while pulling hard away from kennel, wide eyed, frantic, let dog settle and would approach handler for attentions and treats with soft body and tucked tail wag, hesitantly followed treats tossed into kennel, had to use slight leash pressure to further guide dog into kennel, dog would come forward and allowed handler to remove leash by hand.
10/31/2026
Dog was closed outside for cleaning, came forward with soft face and body, wagging tail. Eagerly accepted treats. Retreated away from leash, stood in back of kennel, head down, facing away. Handler stepped into kennel, coaxed dog by name, offered treats. Dog ate treats, flinched away from leash. Dog laid down, handler was able to leash with large loop. Dog exited kennel, some stop and go, nervous. Handler stepped into yard, dog would not follow, pulled back on leash, began biting leash, lightly chewing it. Handler walked dog away, kept leash out of reach, used treat trail to guide dog into yard, dropped leash. Dog explored cautiously, tail down. Kept some distance from handler initially. Handler approached, spoke softly, dog wagged tail, head low, came forward to handler. Dog leaned in, allowed all petting. A little grabby when taking treats from hand. Became warmer with handler, following around yard, seeking attention. Slow walk back to kennel, sniffing. Appeared nervous to pass reactive dogs, needed leash guidance. When approaching own kennel, began pulling back hard on leash, biting at it. Handler got dog's attention by shaking treat bag, made continuous high-value treat trail into kennel, dog followed in. Leash removed by clip lead.

soft wiggly body, tucked tail. allowed all handling and restraint for vaccine. walked to kennel halfway, stop and go, will back up when leash pressure is applied. once by other kennels with other dogs, will lay down and start backing away while biting at leash. bucketed dog rest of way to kennel.

Once in yard dog was hesitant to exit taxi, pancaked and tense bodied, would soften when approached with relaxed ears and soft eyes when petted, only exited taxi when tipping taxi over. 11/11/2026
Updating level to NHO status
11/9/2026
Laying on bed with tense body, hard staring handler and low growling, no interest in treats offered or coaxing. Started to slowly cower away when presented leash, able to place leash with no issues. Walked behind handler on way to sick yard, stop n go, wary of handler otherwsie no issues walking to yard. In yard hard stared handler when placing leash stopper, paced by play yard exit as handler walked away, would spend all of time in yard laying/sitting near play yard exit with ears alert, wide eyed, low growls if approached by handler, chuffs at handler as handler walked away. Tolerant of handler kneeling down to let dog sniff but dog will start to cower away from handler, some gentle jumping up onto play yard exit gate. Able to recover leash and place clip leash with no issues. Walked with some pulling back to kennel, walked into kennel on own, used clip leash for leash retrieval.
11/7/2026
Laying on bed; handler approached; verbally coaxed; opened kennel door; dog approached right away; soft; tail wagging; constantly coughing; sat at front; allowed handler to place leash over head; exited; walked well; froze when female volunteer walked past; continued walking. In yard, approached handler; allowed for all petting; soft; explored; frequently checked in with handler; took treats gently; approached yard fence when familiar staff approached; sniffed through fence; brief tail wags; continued exploring; would approach handler when coaxed; soft; tail wagging; leaned into petting. Walked well back to kennel; entered kennel; allowed for leash removal.
11/5/2026
On approach, dog was curled up on kuranda bed, watching handler approach w/ furrowed brow, moist soft eyes, ears flat to sides of head, lips pulled into a bit of a grimace. As handler greeted & spoke to her in soft, bright tone, she would occasionally shift/adjust, turn face away, issued a couple of whiny groans but otherwise did not stir much. All movement appeared sluggish & laborious for her. No interest in coming closer to claim treats handler offered (liver-flavored small training treats).
Handler was able to decoy-step into kennel, reach and gently leash dog, stood w/ arm outstretched into keennel to keep it as loose as possible, stood to side of open kennel gate to offer unobstructed path out, dog did not rise from bed. Handler closed door to room/5-pack entry and stood by it to ensure no entry & opened dog's kennel, moved away from it completely, dog still did not rise from bed. After several minutes to allow her opportunity to come out, handler opted to end session. Handler decoy-stepped into kennel, offered treats slowly & gently to dog by hand. She softly snuffled at them, tentatively ate a few, handler deposited the rest of jackopt on her bed in front of her, gently removed leash by hand.
11/4/2026
Dog was lying down on kuranda bed when approaching kennel while having eyes closed.  Able to verbally coax to lift head & approach front of kennel.  Presented leash, dog would become relaxed while opening kennel gate with a wiggly body.  Leashed without issues.  Walked to sick PY while having a relaxed body, stopping to do a full body stretch while yawning then continued to walk to PY.  Would explore with a soft body & tail wag.  Approached handler on own, allowing all petting & taking treats gently.  Not interested in toys.  Able to call dog over for more petting.  Dog would return to exploring with nose to ground while sniffing.  Allowed handler to approach & pet while dog would be sniffing nose to ground.  Picked up leash & walked back to kennel without issues.  Entered into kennel & allowed leash removal to be done by hand.
11/4/2026
Dog did not eat dry kibble offered previous day. WIll be adding 2 TBS of canned food during PM feeding if dog does not eat dry kibble offered in AM feeding.
11/2/2026
Dog was standing @ front of kennel with a relaxed & wiggly body.  Opened kennel gate & presented leash, dog would retreat to kuranda bed, would roll over to expose belly, would not come forward.  Able to step fully into kennel & drape leash onto dog while dog would be lying down.  Walked out of kennel with verbal coaxing.  Entered into PY with a relaxed body.  Would explore with nose to ground.  Not interested in treats or toys.  Would approach handler & allow all petting without issues.  Returned to exploring, able to approach dog & pet.  Dog would follow handler to bench, would place front paws onto bench while leaning in for more petting.  Picked up leash & walked back to kennel.  Entered into kennel without issues & allowed leash removal to be done by hand.
11/1/2026
Low growling on approach with tail tightly tucked, head lowered, pancaking onto bed, no interest in treats or coaxing, tense/stiff bodied. Able to approach and place leash with no issues, not making eye contact with handler. Wary of handler throughout walk to small play yard, ears pinned back, wide eyed, walking behind handler with tail tucked. In yard dog was distant from handler all of time in yard, wary of handler, low growling and alarm barking at handler as handler sat away from dog, tense bodied, wide eyed, pacing near play yard exit. Startled by reactive dogs outside of yard, would not come to handler for treats or coaxing. tenses up and tolerates petting when approached but did not seek out attentions, will low growl as handler walks away. Walked back to kennel with no issues, walked into kennel quickly and allowed handler to remove leash by hand.
10/31/2026
Laying on bed when approached, slightly tense, approached front with looser body and tail wagging when offered treats, backed away with lowered tail when leash presented, offered treats through loop, backed away during first attempt, stayed at front and allowed leashing during second attempt with this method, exited kennel willingly, walked on loose leash to small play yard, brief hesitations along the way, tense body with low tail when outside, shifty gaze, paced yard, solicited attention, several times, refused treats, walked dog to EET office, moderate pulling, rushed past kennel areas, loose body and more neutral tail carriage with some tail wagging once in office, took treats eagerly, solicited attention from multiple female staff including unfamiliar staff, explored room, briefly interacted with puzzle toy, walked back to kennel with light pull, entered kennel willingly, removed leash by hand.
10/30/2026
Soft face, body low, fast tail wag on approach. Retreated to bed when handler opened kennel, allowed handler to step in and place leash. Dog exited kennel. Walked close to handler, tail tucked, easily startled. Needed coaxing and redirection on leash when passing reactive dogs. In yard, dog was affiliative with handler, sought attention, allowed all petting. Began pacing yard, tense, nervous of surroundings. Handler would gently put hands on dog as dog paced, dog would slow and lean in. Moderate nervous pull on return, entered kennel easily, allowed leash removal by hand. Became soft and wiggly as handler closed gate.
10/29/2026
Assisting ACT with AM cleaning* Low growling on approach with tense body and ears alert, hard staring handler with no interest in treats offered, started to hunch over body as handler presented leash. Able to place large loop over dog with no issues. Exited kennel with some pulling on leash, tail tucked, wary of handler turning to look at handler throughout walk to small play yard. In yard dog would tense up when placing leash stopper, little eye contact with handler, tense bodied. Dog appeared conflicted towards handler throughout time in yard, distant from handler but will follow handler if handler walked around yard, if handler sat down dog would retreat to corner of yard jumping onto fence line and pacing, began alarm barking/low growling while hard staring if handler approached with stiff body, no interest in treats offered, would turn head away and not look at handler if fully approached and tolerated petting on head but due to dog's wariness of handler pets were brief. No issues returning to kennel, continued to be wary of handler on way back to kennel, walked into kennel on own, allowed handler to slowly remove leash by hand as dog stood near food bowl.
10/25/2026
Dog was sitting in bed, wide-eyed, slightly stiff body. Handler crouched, used "baby-talk" coaxing. Dog softened, head low, brief tail wags. Allowed gentle petting under chin, cowered away from petting over top of head. Easy to leash with large loop. Dog needed lots of coaxing but eventually hopped out of kennel. Walked quickly, tail tucked, some zig-zag. Very easily startled, nervous of surroundings. Handler initially took dog to quiet M&G room. Dog paced room, would approach handler briefly, allow petting, then continue to pace. Very interested in treats, took them eagerly, put front feet onto handler's leg. Wagged tail, allowed more petting. Dog ran to door, whined. Handler walked dog to outside yard for potty break. Dog was very nervous of reactive dogs in indoor kennels, cowered back, needed coaxing and leash guidance to pass them. In yard, dog paced, sniffed, relieved self. Dog would come to handler when called, allowed petting, but was easily distracted and would run off, continuing to pace yard with tail tucked. Male handler entered yard. First handler kept hold of leash. Dog immediately began deep whining, then low growling at male handler. Hackles raised, tail tucked, tense body. Dog kept distance from male handler. Male handler crouched, offered hand, dog slowly got closer, sniffed hand, tolerated petting on top of head but remained tense, then backed away and retreated behind female handler. Male handler exited yard. First handler walked dog back inside. When standing still, dog would pace circles on leash around handler, would not settle. Entered new 5-pack kennel easily, leash removed by hand. Dog softened, wagged tail as handler placed food bowl inside kennel.
10/29/26 05:55 Updating color status
10/23/2026
while taking her out of kennel noticed no pee or poop in kennel. Went to play yard and peed and pooped alot.
10/22/2026
Laying on bed with some tense body, ears alert, little eye contact with handler. Remained in place as handler placed leash, started to come forward to exit kennel on own but froze, gently accepted treat before handler was able to scoot dog out of kennel, walked with easy leash pull to small play yard, tucked tail, wary of handler with constant looking back at handler, will freeze up on walk if too close to handler but able to coax thru, startled by reactive dogs in passing. In play yard dog tolerated petting when placing leash stopper but quickly evaded away from handler, went potty, spent all of evaluation distant from handler, pacing with tail tucked and tense body, would allow handler to slowly approach to kneel down and pet but did not solicit attentions, wide eyed, ears alert, tense body. Dog would soften for female staff members that approached fence line, jumping on fence to sniff with neutral tail and softer body while making quick side eye towards handler if approached, retreats from handler. Dog had a moment of alarm barking with stiff body when approached by handler but settled, no interest in treats offered. Picked up leash and walked back to kennel with no issues, wary of handler reaching down to carry into kennel but allowed all handling, tensed up body with wide eyes, subtle attempt to pull away. Placed into kennel and removed leash by hand with no issues.
10/21/2026
Timid, tense body, hunched over. Allowed restraint for vaccines. Carried to kennel.
